references.text: Here the age for Levitical service is changed to 25 years, and it is set that they shall retire at the age of 50, which supplements and modifies the provision in Num 4:3.
David counts the Levites from 30 years and upward, in accordance with the age requirement established in Numbers 4:3.
Here the age for Levitical service is lowered to 20 years, showing a development from the original age limit of 30 years.
The same age requirement (30–50 years) is repeated for Gershon's sons and their service in the tabernacle.
The same age requirement (30–50 years) is repeated for Merari's sons and their service in the tabernacle.
Summarizes the age requirement for all who were mustered for service in the tent of meeting.
Jesus was about 30 years old when he began his ministry, which can be seen in connection with the Levites' start of service at the age of 30.
